findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Casimir.lean:81` `def sl2Casimir ... (h e f : L)` and `:194` `sl2CasimirHom`; `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Basic.lean:345` `namespace IsSl2Triple`, `:396` `linearIndependent_isSl2Triple`, `:415` `basisOfIsSl2Triple`; Mathlib `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Sl2.lean:102` `IsSl2Triple.toLieSubalgebra`. Note also that this PR's own `exists_lieEquiv_forall_mem_rootSpace` calls the same object a `lieEquiv`, and `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie` uses no `Aut` name anywhere (grep for `Aut\b` in `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie`: no matches).
findings.fix: Put the section in `namespace IsSl2Triple` and use dot notation (`t.weylAut`, `t.weylAut_apply_e`), as `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Basic.lean:345` and Mathlib's `IsSl2Triple.toLieSubalgebra` do; failing that, mark the names `sl2WeylAut`/`sl2WeylAut_apply_e` in the style of `sl2Casimir`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.weylAut` is a bare, unqualified name for a construction that is only meaningful for an sl₂ triple, in a repo that already has Weyl-group material (`TauCeti.weylVector`, `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Weyl/Vector.lean:34`). Every adjacent sl₂ declaration either carries the marker in the name or lives in the triple's namespace; this one does neither, so `TauCeti.weylAut` reads as "the Weyl automorphism" of nothing in particular. The lemma family `weylAut_apply`, `weylAut_apply_h/e/f`, `weylAut_apply_of_lie_eq_zero`, `weylAut_apply_of_lie_eq_smul`, `weylAut_apply_sub_smul`, `lie_weylAut_apply` inherits the same problem.

findings.evidence: General family in `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/InnerAutomorphism.lean:104,110,114,122` is `TauCeti.expAd_apply_of_lie_eq_zero` etc.; the new lemmas at `WeylAutomorphism.lean:111-146` all take `(t : IsSl2Triple h e f)` yet share that prefix and namespace.
findings.fix: Move them into `namespace IsSl2Triple` alongside the rest (`t.expAd_e_apply_h`), so the triple context is in the namespace rather than implied by unbound letters.
findings.issue: `expAd_e_apply_h`, `expAd_e_apply_f` (:117), `expAd_neg_f_apply_h` (:127), `expAd_neg_f_apply_f` (:134), `expAd_neg_f_apply_e` (:138) are sl₂-triple-specific but take the `expAd_` prefix that the general API of `InnerAutomorphism.lean` owns in the same `TauCeti` namespace, and the letters `e`, `f`, `h` denote nothing at the root namespace. A reader browsing `TauCeti.expAd_*` cannot tell that these five silently require `IsSl2Triple h e f`, while `TauCeti.expAd_apply_of_lie_eq_zero` holds for any `x`, `y`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Rat.lean:58` `instance _root_.DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra : Algebra ℚ R`; also `:36` `DivisionSemiring.toNNRatAlgebra`. Uses of the current name: `InnerAutomorphism.lean:37,42,70` and `WeylAutomorphism.lean:270,274`.
findings.fix: Rename to `LieAlgebra.toRatLieAlgebra` (or `toRatLieAlgebra` in `TauCeti`), matching `DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra`, and update the two uses in the module docstring and `exists_lieEquiv_forall_mem_rootSpace`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.ratLieAlgebra` names a scalar-restriction structure the way a ℚ-form of a Lie algebra would be named — a different object this roadmap will actually need (Chevalley ℤ-form, Kostant form). Mathlib names the analogous structure by the `to<Target>` pattern in the source namespace.

summary: Statement strength matches name strength throughout and no notation is added, but the sl₂-triple construction and its lemma family sit in the flat `TauCeti` namespace with no sl₂ marker, breaking the convention of the adjacent Sl2 files and colliding with existing Weyl-group material; `ratLieAlgebra` also departs from Mathlib's `toRatAlgebra` naming for the same kind of structure.
